# PART I
# THE TRUTH ABOUT DISCIPLINE

[[PAGE_BREAK]]

# Chapter I
# The Truth About Motivation

"The pattern that our society follows..."

Friends, as we all think -Motivation is the only key to success? Right? My dear friend, your thought is very common among us --a society that follows patterns, patterns that does not make sense, but the actual truth is not in the society it is in the pattern that we follow --The pattern that says; "MOTIVATION IS THE ONLY KEY TO SUCCESS". If we think about it, yes it is actually a part to success, but not the only key to success; as a breakdown think about the door of success which is locked by a lock, in which we want keys to unlock it, but as I mentioned --"keys" to unlock it not a single key like the motivation key or the inspiration key. They all have specific patterns to unlock the lock, to open the door of success. The lock does not have a specific amount of holes to insert keys, every lock is manufactured in different-different ways and in different-different factories. Every lock is made up of different ambitions, passions, missions and professions, and every lock also needs a different type of key to unlock the lock which, locks the door of success.

So, my dear friend, please promise me that you will not be the one to go with those society's patterns, and that you will teach the same thing to your generation that..

..Motivation is not the only thing needed for success; --The lock of success has many holes for many keys to be put in in order to unlock the lock!

"The importance in the beginning with my experience"

As I early mentioned, motivation is the part of success, but do not misunderstand it, it is a part, a key to success, you cannot neither use only motivation to succeed in life nor you can use everything as keys except motivation to open the lock of success. Motivation has an important role in the beginning, it impacts you the most, but everything has a time. Inspiration and motivations hits you the most, I am writing this book is also due to proper amount of motivation in the correct time. As a student I was thinking about writing a book but a question in my mind always run, "What topic on I should make the book.", I needed motivation and a topic, topic to be inspired on but what? I found my answer on my school. One day I was lost in my thoughts about the topic till when my teacher came and as our was making noise, our teacher came and gave a lecture on discipline. I had already focussed my mind on the teacher's lecture, she was trying to understand us the importance of being disciplined, then a student called the ma'am and then she left the class, again I was lost, lost in the thoughts of discipline, then a sudden idea came across my mind, that writing a book and sharing my knowledge about discipline and its importance. I was pleased to be inspired by my maam's teaching and after a few minutes she came back and continued the lecture, lecture about importance of discipline as she mentioned, curiously I tried to understand her words deeply, as the lecture goes I had a boost of ideas in my mind, trying to understand her words deeply, when I had again a sudden attack of idea about sharing my knowledge on the hidden powers of discipline. I was just hitten by the lightning strike of motivation in the correct time.

This was my story, and you can also build your own but do not forget that....

....Everything has a time and a proper amount!

"At The End..."

In the conclusion I will like to tell you that motivation is the part of success, neither trying with only motivation leads to success nor everything else except motivation can lead to success and that is the truth about motivation, everything has a time and it all happens when you will to do, if you will nobody in the universe will try to stop you, nobody! And the universe does not only try to stop you, it will also help you in the field of success. If you will in the battle of success, in the battle universe be the soldier that supports you, protects you, guides you, but these all happens when you will.

Remember; --To win, always will. Your will power is the weapon that helps you the most in the battle field of success. So....

....To win, always will!

[[PAGE_BREAK]]

# Chapter II
# What Discipline Really Is

"The meaning for the world does not matter, the meaning you describe is the..."

What is discipline? Does it is a personality, is it a life style, is it something to be afraid of or is it any weapon? The answer is nothing and everything. Yes, the answer is not any specific word, both you and me are unable to describe the word discipline. The word discipline means different to every living being, all animals have there different meanings for describing this word. So, is it a thing to be scared on? For this question, the answer is --No! Some people may consider it as but discipline is not a thing to be afraid of, consider it as your best friend and then it will be so and consider it as your enemy to make it your enemy. My friend, never consider the meaning of discipline can be described in a specific sentence. Always ask yourself the question --What does Discipline means to me? It does not matter what the world describes it, your definition matters to you! no one in the world can describe the meaning of discipline to you, only you can.

So, always remember....

....The meaning that the world says does not matter, your definition matters to you!

"For me it is..."

Friend, we had talked about discipline for you and now it is my time to tell my story, about how it changed my life... My school and books changed my lifestyle in many ways, yes, discipline also counts in it. I was a type of student who does not care about anything, anything! I was a type of wierdo. And also I were scared of discipline, I was always trying to avoid it that time till that day came... A boring school lecture, again about discipline, time managements etc blah blah [for me at that time]. I was trying to avoid it, but the word discipline was running on my mind --What is it? Everyone in the class was talking about it as it is a power that most of the student does not had, but why? Why does not all people living in this world posses this ability? Then a question ran on my mind --Am I disciplined? I was such a person who does not thinks about these kinds of question, and it blew my mind --Why I am thinking about this? I was not a student like this so, why is these types of thoughts running in my mind? Why am I thinking about this? What does this word --Discipline means? And then I had quieten --OK I will now try to find about this word. I read books on books but nothing explained the answer --WHAT IS DISCIPLINE? I was trying to find the meaning so I can escape from that thoughts running in my mind. Day on day, books on books, lectures about disciplines, asking to the toppers and yes they all answered me different-different types of answer and then I stopped thinking that toppers of my class know the answer. I then asked the same question to my bestie --My friend, do you know the meaning of the word --discipline? And the answer was absolutely surprising. I had already talked him about my experience about asking toppers reading articles etc.. He then said, "There is no specific answer for that.", smilingly, he continued, "It is you. You, who describes the meaning!". I was amused to listen to this type of answer. I whole way of seeing the world was changed. The next day, I was a totally changed person in many ways. I was a disciplined boy! What a surprise for a careless boy, who didn't knew at that time that he was following discipline. I was following discipline, a boy who wanted the answer, just to stop thinking about discipline was now following discipline.

What a change, huh? You can also do it. Just ask yourself....

....The meaning for you matters!

"Change on Heart. How it changed my life."

How it change my life? It changed me in many ways but slowly ---gaining uses patient! As I said it changed the way I see the world, I was a new person as I am being recycled from a waste! What a surprise? I was looking the world in a new way, a seed was germinating in my mind to clear the pollution their was the pollution that factories of bad thoughts spread. Even now I have those factories in my mind but there is enough trees to clean the air and stop me from freaking out again. My friend, you also have the seed for germination but we want to plant it properly, water it daily, help the seed to stay away from the pollution so it can grow later smoothly, yes gaining takes time --a lot of time! Those who are patient gains it easily, and those who want to learn patients needs to plant more trees of good thought slowly - slowly it also teaches you patients. I was also not patient at that time, I was slowly changing my habits and it was very beneficial for my mental health to then with a good mental health and everyday helping good thought trees my student life was also being effected which later helped to became me the topper of my exams, the people who called me fool were giving respect to me. It was a great change, but it does not happened in a second, the trees take time to grow.

Never quit to anything that takes time. Always remember....

....Gaining takes time!

"Why does gaining take time?"

We talked that gaining takes time - gaining takes time ---but why? Because we don't understand the difference values of temporary instant happiness and long term durable but time taking reward's that give happiness. Do you had ever played a game? In it we are presented with a rank or reward which makes us happy and therefore we play it again. But long termed progress is hardest to achieve. You, me and all people, we all are like bamboos, the bamboos which need time to grow, bamboos take their most of the time to grow under the soil and then, when it comes out of the soil, it very quickly grows and becomes mature in a short period of time. most of us get unsatisfied with the long period and gets under the soil forever, friend, the success is in the sky, quieting at very beginning means to quit at the start. Thus, the gaining takes time --a lot of time!

My friend, remember....

....Quick reward means small rewards and long term progress means durable and long term investments in the bank of Happiness!

"At The End..."

At the end of this chapter, I would like to conclude that there is no certain specific definition for discipline, and by knowing the definition does not work properly, you want to fertilize the soil to support the proper growth of the plant, you want to take time to --a little time minimum. First your habits change from your thinking, then the mental health becomes better, day by day, your confidence grows and the way people see you changes. Growing a tree takes time. Gaining takes time and your patience also grows slowly.

Remember....

....Discipline grows slowly!

[[PAGE_BREAK]]

# Chapter III
# Why Most People Fail?

"What is the problem?"

What is the main problem which creates failure? Is it because we lack knowledge? Do you know that studying daily helps you in exams or saving money daily at least a little helps in financial independence? So why people fail in maintaining or obtaining discipline? The problem is not in knowledge. The problem is not also a specific, not everyone in the world fail with same problem. A man knowing that he is eating a lot and needs to be fit may start an exercise to do daily and a balanced diet according to which he will eat daily so he can lose weight and become fit, --This idea works, both you and me accepts it? As planned the next day he wakes up early in the morning, goes to gym, eats according to diet like green leafy vegetables which the man not likes is now his daily meal, --Think a little, one day a great thing happened in your life, the world decides that everyone will now eat the food that you like the most, but after a few weeks, a new president or a prime minister comes and says that, "my dear people, the old rule that the old president/prime minister made is wrong because people are now eating only the food they like and not eating other food, and because of it people are lacking vitamins and minerals. So they will only eat the things that they don't like for a whole year.", this event can be the terrifying event in you life and for me too, but now we both are forced to eat and no one can change this! What a nightmare! There will be nothing to think about if that country increases the number of suicide. What will you do if you have a second option too? What if you can quit everything and can eat at least a balanced diet once? What will you do? --I will absolutely quit. And may you too. The problem is not in the knowledge that we posses the problem is in the habits that we use, our laziness says, "quit today everything, and you will be able to sleep a little more, eat something new or can do anything?", our bad habits say, "Behave like a don today and everyone in the class will behave as your slave" --but will you think in that time that the classmates will also become your enemy and will revenge you when they will get a chance, the social media says, "Come and watch this so you will be happy, come here, come here to remove the stress of study or of office work?" --and will you think in this time that your class or pending work or the office work you are lefting will become more burden. My friend, the problem is not in the knowledge it is in our thoughts.

Always remember; --The problem of failure is not because you lack knowledge the problem is in the....

....Thoughts you posses!

"Is Failure Good?"

Is happening failure again and again good? Most of our answer will be --no, but why? The real answer is not that we think. Think it as a special hand glove, this hand glove is special because it has two faces; --one the smiley face and second the angry face. When somebody tries to fear it on the right hand a smiley face comes and nourishes the user with happiness. but if you wear it on the left hand the angry face appears, it makes the user very angry. We all have those gloves in our mind, our mindset. our mindset decides which could be a wrong decision and which could be beneficial. Bad mindset says bad thoughts are good and the good thoughts are the real villain. And as programmed our mind follows our mindset. There is a lot of different in --"I am failure" and "I am failed". Think, the mindset of Raj is like "I am a failure, I am dumb" and the mindset of Ran is "I am failed, its OK, next time I will be better". Raj is afraid of exams while Ran does not feel any reason for that. One day they had a test, a surprise test, the Raj had gotten six out of ten and Ran got five. The teacher wanted the best from the class, and she had expected more from Raj and Ran. She explained Raj and Ran to give their best in the next test. Raj was sad, he was lost in the thoughts, in the bad thoughts, --"I am a failure, I am a dumb...". When he was studying, he was lost their too, therefore, he was not able to study well. but Ran's case was different, she was happy, she was thinking that, "I didn't got full, but I my teacher explained my mistake, so now I can focus on that topic.". With this happy and grateful mind, she was able to study well. As the next test came, ran had gotten the most numbers in the class and Raj was failed with only a half marks. So there is no good or bad in failure it is in our mindset, and our duty is to change our mindset, to plant the tree of good thoughts.

So, remember....

....The good or bad features of failure comes with our mind!

At The End...

So, in the end of this chapter I will like to conclude that, failure has an important role in our lives. It is a test for the real coming exams of life. It is the exam of our life. It tries to tell us that how life is. How to handle failure and importantly it shows us our weaknesses. On which we can concentrate and understand our weaknesses. It is our hidden teachers who shows the right path.

So, remember....

....Failure is the teacher who shows us the right path.

[[PAGE_BREAK]]

# Chapter IV
# The Identity Shift

"Becoming Different..."

My friend, what is a your identity to you? Is it a positive attitude or a negative attitude? Most of the people might think that "Why is this topic important? I don't want to read it I am quieting" ---But why, why do people think about their thoughts, personalty etc... are terrible to think on. The answer might be something that they know but they will not think about it a second. Why do they do so? The actual answer is that they do not like their identity, they are tied of a rope whose colour tells the personalty of the person, and if it will be a bad personality or colour and it will become a rope which does not give a chance to them to think about creating a new personality and therefore they cannot escape the current identity and create a new one, but if they knew, if they knew that there is way to create one? Actually there is no need of creating a new personalty or any identity, they just need to change their way, their way of thinking and seeing things, changing makes a new personality using the initial behaviour, we all at least have one good habit and keeping that habit might be the best thing in you and creating a new attitude would might change it and you would lost your most favourite behaviour. One thing can happen that all of us around you might love that behaviour but the inner you, your heat would never accept that the new personalty, the new character change in you is the best. So the real truth is that we want to paint the rope not from colour but from thoughts, thoughts that change the colour naturally.

So, my friend always remember....

....Not always cutting the rope nor colouring it with fake colours colours might be the solution, sometimes we want to take our time and think about the solution which is needed.

"Being Trapped"

Do you know when we try to change the way we see the world what happens with us? --We are being trapped, but how? The answer may vary for all but the explanation for all is simple ---Our bad factories, our bad thoughts will never say that ---You are right, we are very bad and harmful to you, we are quieting! These bad thoughts are made of glue that sticks to our mind and our mind is very sensitive when we stretch this glue our mind also stretches, a sudden habitual change can make a huge strike of depression leading more stress and anxiety in our mind and making it impossible to escape them. In that stage we think that trying to escape is not possible, now nothing can change it. But if we have a second chance too? we can escape this trouble by only planting the trees of good thoughts. Actually these factories run when you think about bad things, if we avoid them, we made it, but this is not easy as we think, imagine a time, in which we are trying to avoid our bad thoughts would be difficult. But if we try to think about good thoughts only, the situation might vary from the first time, the possibilities of getting rid of bad thoughts would be higher, as good thoughts, our trees automatically clean the pollution of the factories, reducing bad thoughts which reduces anxiety, stress, depression and so on, which is the best of avoiding the bad thoughts.

Remember....

....Making a new personalties does not end every problem, we are always hitten by challenges!

"My identity was..."

How was my identity, first? As I had already said, I was a careless boy, I was a boy who try to avoid everything, everything! I was lazy, a trouble maker and so on. I always try to avoid about what kind of person I was. And after that accident happened in my life, my whole life had changed. I every time tried to avoid bad thoughts, which was very difficult. I would always try to be perfect in discipline, but as a careless boy I could not change my whole character at one day, as I said gaining takes time but this time was too difficult to me to bare. I was trying and trying and trying! But I was confused, trying to understand why I am not being disciplined although I had understand the meaning of the word discipline and what more the world wants from me? The friend whom I had described earlier was sick so he was unable to come school but after a week he joined us again that day was another important time for me in my whole life! In the games period we were permitted to go on the ground and play with friends. I was playing with my friend when I asked him about why I can't keep being discipline? He answered calmly with a smile, Trees take time to grow, masons take time to build, food takes time to digest, then why can't discipline? I was more confused rather than realised. Then I went to home, tried to keep discipline, done my work and at night almost at 8:00pm I slept wondering about my friend's word, I thought ---OK the trees take time, the masons take time and the food takes time, OK, but why he had said that discipline takes time? Social media highlights quick achievements, most of the lectures talk about quick achievements, most of the interviews, media everything says about quick achievements, then I felt asleep. The nest day in my mind that words ran, I searched about motivational speakers talking about time, still that same two words; "quick", "achievements"! Then I directly asked him about his meaning he said that things take time to improve and I then directly said on his mouth that you are telling me wrong social media, lectures and so many platforms highlight quick achievements! He calmly said every thing has a property of time which is written in the book of life with everybody's name, and that property tells how time does a thing take to achieve. I was bloomed by astonishment. I had understand his meanings and that day onwards I gave my one best everyday and increased perfection by 1% till my nature became naturally disciplined

So, always remember....

....Identity change is not a sudden lightning! Everything takes its own time!

"But Why Identity?"

But why changing identity can help? My friend, Life is your best friend and the one of the best teacher also. But this teacher makes the tests very hard. The teacher always want you to give your best, so he decides to make the hardest test that only you, only you can do it! But there is also another teacher, the Time, he is in charge of editing the test. As the Time teacher edits and adds more questions and in that questions, there is one main question that he adds that he actually edits the question and adds that you will need a lot of time in which you are confident. And one of the hardest paper's hardest question to became discipline is modify your identity! In this question, most of us will read the first part and either try to do it or quit at first. But we are forgetting something, something that we need to read the question completely before answering it we avoid or forget to read the instructions beneath the question. The instruction that says this question needs a lot of with a focus on goals and destiny, this needs a lot of confidence and much more things to be answered. And we fools forget to read this session! My friend, stop reading this and take a break of one minute, in that time imagine what other things can be happened after reading those instructions!

So, remember....

....Be patient and never quit doing in life even it is not important as the other things are, small things can change life a lot!

"At The End..."

At the end of this chapter, I will like to conclude you that, changing identity can help a lot but becoming a different can be the most terrible thing in the world! And changing the only identity does not change problems yes that's true that it make things better but always there are challenges that can be queitten they only can be beated! My identity also was terrible before following discipline but after following, I was also trying to pick up a new identity, but picking a new identity is not the solution we wan to try to modify or change i a little, we want to add good habits in that identity, but this also takes time! Being patient is the most important thing to give in the test of life, so be it!

Remember....

....All things happen when its time comes!

[[PAGE_BREAK]]

# PART II
# THE PSYCHOLOGY OF SELF-CONTROL

[[PAGE_BREAK]]

# Chapter V
# The Science Of Willpower

"What makes willpower so powerful?"

So, what makes willpower so powerful? My dear friend, we all know, willpower has a special ability that if our mind, body and soul comes together to achieve something, or in other words, if we have willpower and a little confidence, the whole universe comes with us to help in our journey to our success. If you are a comic writer and you have willed to write an awesome volume, even your enemies will give your idea, not directly nor indirectly, but your mind will be focused on deep thinking and it will collect all the best ideas from your environment, the environment in which you live, your enemies tease you, your family lives and the environment where you write your comics. Your mind is most willed when the deadline is coming. Have you ever wonder about why your class's some backbenchers are listed in the name of toppers? Even science had defined about this topic as the exams come their mindset changes from; I will done later --> I want to done now! This mindset is forced to study well, learn everything and much more as they only have one day to prepare for this exam, their mind forces focus to be activated and this situation forces also our mind to catch the flow state in which we are lost in studying that we even forget about time is going. But there is no need of your mind also become like backbencher, you just only need to study well and involved. As I said about the flow state, it is also a part of willpower as willpower activates it quickly leading us to be deeply involved in our activity which we are doing.

So, remember....

....If we are sticked to do anything, the whole universe helps us to complete that task!

"Be willing..."

How to be willing? There is nothing much needed to be willed, we just need a little confidence and we want to stick on the topic or the activity you are doing and continue flowing in it, slowly the whole universe will be with you! But this also is not easy! Trees require time to grow! And many of us cut down the tree without waiting for it to grow so we can use the trunk and this impatience also wastes our time of trying to achieve, time we spent for the planting of the tree, and our hard work also is wasted because of this impatience we cut the tree at first stage and then we will be depressed by our work! Then why doing so? Can we can just wait a little to achieve the result, the ripe fruit? Willing also requires patient but not that much as it also builds patience. But still we are unable to be willed although we have the required qualities, but why? This is because, we are willed when our mind, body and soul are focused on one thing! And when our mind is focused, our body is anywhere else and when the body is with our soul the mind has disappeared from our head! Thus we does not focus in a same topic and we are unable to be willed.

Remember....

....To be willed, our mind, body and our soul wants to be focused on one topic.

"At The End..."

At the end of this chapter, I will like to conclude you that, willing is a very incredible tool. It helps us to achieve that we have committed and with this commitment the whole universe will help you to find your destiny! Being willing is not simple as it looks, our mind, our body, and our soul needs to be united on one topic, which typically is very hard to be obtained, but keep trying makes it very easy to achieve! And my friend, willing can break many times! but we just want to keep trying to achieve, we want to commit to attain in order to obtain it!

Always remember....

....Being willed is not as easy as we think!

[[PAGE_BREAK]]

# Chapter VI
# Habits: The Invisible Architects of Your Life

"Designing lives..."

Habits are our invisible architects of our lives, but we want to remember that a coin has two sides. Similarly there are also two types of these architects; The good one and the bad one. The good habits are the architect who build a positive and disciplined character. Day by day we repeat good tasks, these tasks then become our good habits. Everyday our good habits place a brick to the building of our character according to our repeatetion of them. If we repeat them in a healthy way we can make that building fast and more strong than normal the buildings. But the bad ones are the real villain. If you repeat them, they will come to your building and they will take a brick directly from the bottom, making the building unstable till we repair it by using good habits. But this cannot be happen if we do not use our good habits. And if we did not used them the building will eventually fall after a few bad habits! Making this building's base is not easy also if the, building has fell making it again will become very hard to be done, making it nearly impossible! But there is a chance, a chance of building the base again from start. But this will require all of the good habits you posses and it also can need some other habits also which you are able to create. After this we want to only avoid the bad habits, which either is not simple! And slowly slowly, you will be able to build a base, and then a building! But remember it will also take a lot of time!

So, remember.....

.....If the building fell once, making the whole foundation once again will be terrible!

"A coin has two sides..."

As I early mentioned, a coin has two sides, the positive side and the negative side. Our habits also have these two sides, the positive habits and the negative habits, or in simple words; The good habits and the bad habits. The good one includes habits like; giving respect to everyone, helping mentality, humanity and so on. The bad ones include habits like; being insincere, being unpunctual, relying on others and much more. But the most of us use the bad habits like; doing our work from others, make problematic situation, and wasting time and then regretting on it. And the good habits we commonly use are; helping others, being disciplined and a few more. Yes, we only have a few good habits and a lot numbers of bad habits. This is because we make our bad habits more satisfying than our good habits are. But why? Why does our bad habits are more satisfying than our good habits? The answer is simple, when we repeat a thing more our mind starts to considered it as satisfying but if you cross the limit your mind will make it more unsatisfying rather than making it enjoyable. But when you are forced to do or repeat a habit more and more, our mind makes that habit more unsatisfying. But we can break this simply by just spending our little time doing good habits!

Always remember....

.....There is also a positive side in negative things!

"At The End..."

At the end of this chapter, I will like to conclude that the habits are the architect that help our building of character or behaviour stand but remember bad habits also try to fall them down but the builders still build and repair it! But to do this we want to firstly make the bad habits unsatisfying and try to avoid bad thoughts from controlling us! Every person is born with two sides; the negative or the bad side and the positive or the good side. We do not like more good habits. Our factories of bad thought's employs stop us from doing good habits. Actually we are tied by a rope, a rope which stops us from doing good things again and again and the only way to do good things is to cut the rope not regretting about the bad things you have done, at that point.

Remember....

....Sometimes we want to cut the rope to achieve something but this does not means we want to cut it always!

[[PAGE_BREAK]]

# Chapter VII
# Environment VS Willpower

"Who wins?"

So, who is more powerful? The answer might be different but naturally; Environment Beats Willpower. It breaks it down! Actually environment makes willpower and it can break it down or help it to grow also! Our eyes are able to see visible things, our mind trusts those visible things, our heart attracts to those visible things, but what about the invisibles? The invisibles that form the visibles! Like sir Newton had said, "Every action has a reaction" similarly every visible things are developed by other invisible forces, LIKE OUR ENVIRONMENT! Our willpower is fragile. Some scientist also believe that willpower is limited and reduces upon our uses. But we do not want to be afraid of that, we just want to build a proper environment that can directly lead us to success without using any unreliable sources. Environment is that source that takes time to build and when it is built, it becomes the biggest helper that gives us the most!
